Variable_Definitions: Applicable storage capability, link capability, path capability and workload demand
Applicability: Applicable when the relevant path is quantifiable and its components are evidenced
Limitations: Does not replace architecture/access evidence; missing path components remain INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE

Formula: RAID5=(N-1)*Cmin; RAID6=(N-2)*Cmin; RAID10=(N/2)*Cmin for cited standard layouts.
Variable_Definitions: N=drive count; Cmin=smallest applicable drive capacity
Inputs: Drive count; drive capacity; RAID level

Limitations: Does not select k or m.
